verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents official client libraries that automatically report errors once installed. Coverage spans backend (Python, plus the Oban integration for unhandled worker exceptions), mobile (the Cocoa library auto-reports crashes and errors), and frontend (JS packages with automatic instrumentation and source-map un-minification). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the JS/browser SDK auto-captures uncaught errors, evidence of Android or other mobile SDKs beyond Cocoa, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK auto-capture.
